template: group_normalize(if_else(or(greater(group_rank(winsorize(divide(subtract(vec_median({actual_eps}), vec_median({estimated_eps})), add(abs(vec_median({estimated_eps})), 0.01)), std=4), industry), 0.9), less(group_rank(winsorize(divide(subtract(vec_median({actual_eps}), vec_median({estimated_eps})), add(abs(vec_median({estimated_eps})), 0.01)), std=4), industry), 0.1)), group_zscore(divide(subtract(vec_median({actual_eps}), vec_median({estimated_eps})), add(abs(vec_median({estimated_eps})), 0.01)), industry), 0), industry)
idea: 稳健中位数双尾隔离策略。使用vec_median替代均值以降低离群值影响，经winsorize截尾后计算行业内分位（group_rank），仅保留行业前10%与后10%的极端股票（中间置零），实现"只有两端有信号"的纯多头/空头暴露，并经group_normalize确保行业中性。
